note: How gear icons look (looks plan L2). Every gear piece names one of `shapes` in its `icon` field (tools/content/gear_icons.py fills it in from the piece's name); the art is src/art/icons/gear-<shape>.webp, painted with a red accent and gold trim. The accent takes the weapon's element color, or the element of a set piece's zone, or the tier's own accent. The trim takes the tier color for the piece's level. Looks only: nothing here changes a fight.
